def has_row(conn, entity_type, entity_id, today):
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT 1 FROM stock_fundamentals "
        "WHERE entity_type = ? AND entity_id = ? AND snapshot_date = ? LIMIT 1",
        (entity_type, entity_id, today),
    ).fetchone()
    return row is not None


def create_index(op):
    op.execute(
        "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_anomalies_dedupe "
        "ON anomalies (entity_id, pattern_type)"
    )
